behaviors: Preserved operator-versus-host distinction: real guarded plugin routes refuse operator scope with403 while invalid/view/triage/provider credentials receive401 and the host performs the allowed operation. Existing plugin_manager suite supplies those positive and negative network floors.

The actual host-denial function is invoked in an isolated subprocess with both header and query scoped credentials. Parent captures two denial logs with actual scope and JSON-escaped label; response contains neither identity details nor bearer. Pure projection test verifies exact scope/label/fingerprint, host/unknown/empty refusal, bounded long labels and unlabelled fallback.

Child regression explicitly checks host query-token authorization and the unconfigured direct HTTP predicate. Hub::start still separately refuses tokenless network listeners; no admission or caller grants are widened.

ScopedIdentFor diagnostic behavior is restored as auth::scoped_diagnostic, an allowlisted metadata projection rather than a serialized credential Record. Unknown metadata, presented bearer and request URI are never logged.
